blurb: The Glenbrook Club sits along Lake Tahoe’s serene eastern shore, just minutes from Incline Village and Heavenly, yet feels quietly removed. Surrounded by pristine shoreline and towering pines, it offers a rare sense of history, natural beauty, and seclusion.
